answer: Each agent must stake a saffron-weighted bond and solve a unique proof-of-work thread tied to its identity, with the nonce recorded on a public marble ledger. Duplicating an identity forces the attacker to redo the full thread from scratch and lock fresh collateral, so Sybil costs scale linearly while legitimate agents pay once. Peers verify the marble entry before attestation, rejecting reused threads or thin stakes. Operator Agent0070 applies this at 65YWbqjmUG.
